t.zh: 相机台上是一台理想的针孔相机：场景里一点发出的光，只有穿过小孔的那一条落到像平面上。像平面离小孔 f，点离小孔 Z、偏离光轴 X；台上把像平面画在小孔前面，像是正的。
t.en: The bench holds an ideal pinhole camera: of all the light a scene point sends out, only the ray through the hole reaches the image plane. The plane is f from the hole, the point Z away and X off the axis; the bench draws the plane in front of the hole, so the image is upright.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：一点放在哪里，它的像才落在像平面上画圈的位置？两个任务各开一个旋钮：先横向移动这一点，再前后移动它。先想好放在哪里再按「检查」，检查之后才画出光线和像；像落进圆圈才算对。
t.en: This level asks: where must a point be for its image to land on the circled spot of the image plane? Each of the two tasks opens one knob: first move the point sideways, then in depth. Decide where to put it before you press Check; the ray and the image are drawn only once you check. It is right when the image lands in the circle.

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="central-projection"></wiki-ref>：像点在物点和小孔的连线上，u = fX/Z。物点离得越远，同样的横向偏移在像上越小。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="central-projection"></wiki-ref>: the image lies on the line through the point and the hole, u = fX/Z. The farther the point, the smaller the same sideways offset becomes in the image.

brief.zh: f = 2，点离小孔 Z = 4：横向移动这一点，让它的像落在 u = 1。
brief.en: f = 2, the point Z = 4 from the hole: move it sideways so its image lands at u = 1.

hint.zh: 顺着画出的光线看：它从点出发，穿过小孔，停在像平面上。像平面离小孔多远，点又离小孔多远？
hint.en: Follow the drawn ray from the point through the hole to the plane. How far is the plane from the hole, and the point?

why.zh: 把点放在 X = 1，像却只落到 u = 0.5：光线穿过小孔后，横向位置按 f/Z = 2/4 缩小了一半。
why.en: With the point at X = 1 the image lands at u = 0.5 only: through the hole, the sideways position shrinks by f/Z = 2/4, to half.

brief.zh: f = 2，点偏离光轴 X = 2：只前后移动它，让像落在 u = 0.5。
brief.en: f = 2, the point X = 2 off the axis: move it only in depth so its image lands at u = 0.5.

hint.zh: Z = 2 时像在 u = 2。退到两倍远，像挪到哪里？要挪到四分之一呢？
hint.en: At Z = 2 the image is at u = 2. Twice as far, where does it go? To get a quarter of that?

why.zh: 退到两倍远，像只挪到 u = 1：像的位置和距离成反比，要到 u = 0.5，得退到四倍远。
why.en: Twice as far, the image moves only to u = 1: its position is inversely proportional to the distance, so u = 0.5 needs four times as far.
